_comment: Hand-authored input of mapgen/generate_terrain_masks.py (#6617). Places the TWW3 IE climate map (sources/originals/tww3_climate.jpg, 2471x1922 px) over the drawn Old World, where the frame registration it otherwise samples through (tww3_ie_parchment.jpg, a whole-map coarse lattice) is off by one to two IE provinces (loremaster review 2026-11-18: Kislev fell in Averland, Karaz-a-Karak in the Western Badlands). The #9016 zone projection does not cover the Old World (its zone 6). Each pair joins a named place on both maps: `source` is the IE climate-map px of the region's printed label (or of a lake or island), `canvas` the mean hub anchor of our states carrying that name (mapgen/config/hub_worksheet.json, 2026-11-18). Both are region-scale, not point-precise, so the fit is a smoothed thin-plate scored leave-one-out (generate_terrain_masks.py --check-placement). Edit deliberately; a moved state or hub does not update these rows. Placed by Claude, 2026-11-18.
